_note: USD per million tokens (MTok), the unit providers quote. Models are matched by the FIRST key found as a substring of the lowercase model name, so list the more specific key before a shorter one that it contains (sonnet-5-5 before sonnet-5). A model matching no key is priced at 'fallback' and flagged on the dashboard. cache_read_multiplier is the cache-hit price as a fraction of the input price and differs by model; a model without its own uses the top-level one. A 'tiers' entry replaces input/output when one call's prompt (fresh input + cache writes + cache reads) is over over_tokens. Cache writes cost cache_write_multiplier x input for the 5-minute TTL and cache_write_1h_multiplier x input for the 1-hour TTL; the logs record which was used. Fast mode, batch and inference_geo=us (1.1x) are NOT priced: calls using them are flagged and priced at the standard rate.
copilot_rate_note: Average cost of one GitHub Copilot code review: 234.92 AI credits ($2.35 at $0.01 per credit) over 8 reviews, from github.com/settings/billing/ai_usage (Code Review model, Nov 1-15 2026). GitHub bills in AI credits, not per request, and a review's cost varies with its size; on a plan with included credits you may be charged nothing. Set to null to show review counts only.
